messages.content: Pump P-101 ki servicing kab karni hai?

Pump P-101 ki **har 500 running hours** ya **har 3 mahine** me servicing honi chahiye, jo pehle ho.

| Kaam | Interval |
|---|---|
| Bearing grease | 500 hrs |
| Seal check | 3 mahine |
| Impeller inspection | 12 mahine |

sources.text: Centrifugal pump P-101 shall be serviced every 500 running hours or quarterly, whichever is earlier.
